payload.claim: The witness for criterion 1 ("every result the suite produced") only checks `len(recorded) > 1` and that the single `tests` entry matches the gate cell's stub; it never asserts which gates are present. Editing saffron/cell/session.py's write to drop the suite's advisory-only entries (e.g. `size`) before serializing would still leave more than one entry and leave the `tests` entry untouched, so both new tests stay green while the file silently stops being "every result the suite produced" as the acceptance criterion and the surrounding comment ("Do not widen it to carry the advisory set too") require.
